t: The republic was proclaimed on 9 November 1918 during the German Revolution, and its constitution was adopted by a National Assembly that met in Weimar in 1919.
The hyperinflation of 1923 raised the price of a loaf of bread from 3 Reichsmarks in 1922 to 80 billion in November 1923, until the Rentenmark stabilised the currency.
The Reichstag Fire Decree and the Enabling Act of 23 March 1933 gave Hitler's government power to act outside parliamentary control, which is widely held to mark the end of the republic.
dyk: The name "Weimar Republic" was first used by Adolf Hitler in 1929; officially the state kept the name German Reich, and the term only became mainstream in the 1950s.
ev: Philipp Scheidemann proclaims the German Republic in Berlin and the abdication of Kaiser Wilhelm II is announced
Women vote for the first time in the election to the National Assembly, which then meets in Weimar
Germany signs the Treaty of Versailles
The Kapp Putsch fails after a general strike and the refusal of the bureaucracy to obey Kapp
French and Belgian troops occupy the Ruhr, hyperinflation peaks, and Hitler's putsch in Munich fails
Paul von Hindenburg is elected president and the Locarno Treaties settle Germany's western borders
The Nazi Party wins 37.3% of the vote and becomes the largest party in the Reichstag
The Reichstag passes the Enabling Act, ending the republic in effect

f.capital: Berlin (the National Assembly met at Weimar in 1919)
f.founder: Proclaimed by Philipp Scheidemann; Friedrich Ebert led the first government
